This full-time role involves driving sales growth by leveraging technical expertise and understanding customer needs. The Sales Engineer will report to the Sales Manager and collaborate with engineering and product teams to implement sales strategies effectively. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Implement the AGA Division market strategy. Maximize sales of Oil Free Air High Pressure products to existing and new customers within Saudi Arabia. Ensure sales targets are met in terms of unit sales and revenue generation. Increase market share in the assigned territory through an efficient and proactive sales approach. Identify High-Pressure applications and define the potential market. Provide input to the BLM and Divisional Product/Segment Managers for product and business improvement. Monitor the overall progress of projects against schedule and milestones in coordination with project engineers, providing early warning of potential slippage and proposing remedial actions to prevent jeopardizing contract completion dates. Contribute to Atlas Copco’s goal of "sustainable productivity". Provide timely and accurate sales and market information. e2354358c1d86034.job_title: Sales Specialist (Food and Veterinary PCR Diagnostics)
e2354358c1d86034.description: About Haven Scientific Haven Scientific is a Saudi-born company headquartered at the Innovation Cluster of King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) in Thuwal, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The company is the sole manufacturer in the MENA region of genomic tests featuring proprietary designs, offering a diverse range of tests including infectious diseases, genetic testing, and nucleic acid isolations. Haven Scientific is committed to R&D, developing solutions tailored to regional needs, and customizing products for the local market with competitive pricing and in-Kingdom support. The Role: Sales Specialist (Food and Veterinary PCR Diagnostics) Haven Scientific is seeking a proactive Sales Specialist to manage and develop strategic relationships with key clients. This full-time role is responsible for ensuring long-term partnerships, customer satisfaction, and revenue growth. The Sales Specialist serves as the primary point of contact between the company and its key accounts, facilitating effective communication, smooth operations, and timely execution of business activities. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key customers, serving as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts. Understand customer needs, operational requirements, and business objectives. Independently identify, pursue, and close new client opportunities from prospecting to the first purchase order. Develop and manage account plans for assigned key accounts in alignment with the sales manager. Achieve assigned targets for both new client acquisition and existing account growth. Prepare quotations and proposals, coordinating with internal departments for successful order processing. Monitor sales performance and maintain an updated sales pipeline in the CRM system. Ensure all invoices are properly uploaded and recorded, following up with customers for timely payment and collection of outstanding invoices. Provide professional support and timely responses to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction. Coordinate product demonstrations, training sessions, and technical support as required. Work closely with internal teams, including sales management, logistics, technical support, finance, and regulatory departments, to ensure smooth order processing and service support. Monitor customer feedback and market developments, reporting customer requirements, market opportunities, and competitor activities to the Sales Manager. Maintain CRM data accuracy and completeness, logging all client interactions, opportunities, and account activities. Compensation and Benefits Haven Scientific offers a competitive salary and a sales incentive plan tied to target achievement. Employees also receive a personalized Individual Development Plan (IDP), additional paid leave dedicated to professional development activities, and 21 working days of annual leave.

e23e079431d2b68a.job_title: Project Controls Engineer - Petrochemical plant project (Saudi Arabia)
e23e079431d2b68a.description: Eram Talent is hiring on behalf of its leading Petrochemical client for a Senior Project Controls Engineer to support major refinery and petrochemical projects. The client is seeking an experienced project controls professional with a strong background in project planning, scheduling, cost control, forecasting, and performance reporting within EPCM and construction environments. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing, monitoring, analyzing, and reporting project performance across scope, cost, schedule, risk, quality, and safety, while ensuring effective project controls systems, accurate forecasting, critical-path management, and alignment with approved project baselines. The role will also involve coordinating and overseeing contractors' project controls activities, providing guidance to project teams, and delivering reliable performance reports to project management and clients. Key Responsibilities Provide guidance, direction, and specialized support for resolving complex project control issues. Calculate, analyze, report, and recommend actions on project data, including schedule, cost, budget, risk, quality, and safety. Develop project cash-flow forecasts. Integrate scope, cost, and schedule within the Work Breakdown Structure and maintain accurate mapping. Analyze, evaluate, and forecast current project status against the approved baseline schedule. Assess the effects of design or construction changes and schedule slippages. Report schedule status to project management, Sadara management, and the client, as applicable. Apply engineering, procurement, and construction terminology, concepts, and relationships. Develop and maintain critical-path logic networks and bar charts. Customize project control systems to meet specific project requirements. Accumulate and maintain historical performance data to support realistic future planning and forecasting. Guide and oversee EPCM & Construction contractors to effectively sett up their project controls & reporting structure. Pro-actively verify & ensure accurate reporting from other project contractors. Supervise and support lower-level project controls engineers or support personnel, when assigned. Perform other responsibilities associated with the position, as required. Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Business Management. Minimum 5 years of experience in refinery or petrochemical plant project activities. Strong practical experience working in a multinational environment. Excellent oral and written communication skills. Ability to analyze and present reports clearly and in an organized manner. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project controls software, including Primavera P6.

e24dd5e25a18f9d3.description: About the Role ASAS for Developing & Operating Industrial Cities is seeking a Safety Expert to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role involves providing specialized technical consultations in occupational safety and health, supporting the development and implementation of safety systems, and managing risks within industrial cities. Job Purpose The primary objective of this role is to offer expert technical advice in occupational safety and health. The Safety Expert will support the development and application of safety standards, manage risks, analyze incidents, and conduct audits and evaluations to enhance compliance and elevate prevention and safety levels in industrial cities, thereby safeguarding lives, property, and assets. Key Responsibilities Provide technical consultations and expertise in occupational safety and health, supporting departments and sites in addressing safety-related risks and challenges. Develop and review safety policies, standards, and procedures, ensuring alignment with approved regulations, bylaws, and professional standards. Conduct advanced risk assessments and analyses for activities, projects, and facilities, proposing appropriate control measures. Implement and review audits and inspections across industrial cities, analyzing results to identify non-compliance and improvement opportunities. Participate technically in investigating serious, recurring, and near-miss incidents, analyzing root causes, and developing corrective and preventive actions. Review safety requirements for projects, operational activities, and contractors, providing technical opinions on safety plans, risk assessments, and safe work procedures. Develop awareness and training programs and preventive initiatives, promoting a safety culture and raising awareness of risks and safe practices. Analyze safety performance indicators, prepare technical reports and studies, and provide recommendations to improve performance and reduce incidents and risks. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Occupational Safety and Health, Engineering, or a related field. 7-10 years of experience in occupational safety and health, with relevant experience in industrial facilities, industrial cities, infrastructure projects, or operations and maintenance. Professional certifications such as NEBOSH Diploma or equivalent. Required Skills and Competencies Advanced ability to analyze and assess risks, and to develop appropriate controls and procedures to mitigate them. Advanced skill in auditing safety systems, reviewing compliance with regulations and standards, and identifying improvement opportunities. Ability to analyze incidents and root causes, and to formulate corrective and preventive recommendations and actions. Ability to provide technical opinions, influence stakeholders, communicate effectively, and make evidence-based decisions. Key Performance Indicators Percentage of audit plans and technical risk assessments executed according to approved plans and schedules. Reduction in the frequency of incidents and major violations resulting from risks within the scope of responsibility. Percentage of approved safety improvement initiatives and recommendations implemented, and their impact on compliance and performance levels.

e2b7084cc3f63414.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ابتكار للتقنية عن فني عمليات تقنية معلومات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تطبيق وتنفيذ الخطط المتعلقة بعمليات تقنية المعلومات، وتقديم الدعم الفني اللازم، وإدارة البيانات والمعلومات بكفاءة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تطبيق وتنفيذ الخطط الفنية المتعلقة بعمليات تقنية المعلومات والالتزام بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. تحديد الأدوات والمستلزمات المطلوبة لعمليات تقنية المعلومات، وتحديد النواقص، ورفعها للمعنيين لتأمينها. تقديم المساعدة الفنية لمهندس وأخصائي تقنية المعلومات في أداء مهامهم وتنفيذ العمليات الموكلة إليهم. حفظ البيانات والمعلومات المتعلقة بعمليات تقنية المعلومات الفنية، والعمل على تبويبها وترتيبها وفق الممارسات المعتمدة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال عمليات تقنية المعلومات أو دور مشابه. فهم جيد للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة لعمليات تقنية المعلومات. القدرة على تحديد الاحتياجات من الأدوات والمستلزمات التقنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في الدعم الفني والمساعدة التقنية. القدرة على تنظيم وحفظ البيانات والمعلومات بدقة. مهارات إعداد التقارير وتوثيق العمل. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المحددة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق متخصص في بيئة ديناميكية تركز على تقديم أفضل حلول تقنية المعلومات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم.

e2ce1c8af883d52e.company_name: SAMREF Saudi Aramco Mobil Refinery Company Ltd.
e2ce1c8af883d52e.description: About the Role SAMREF Saudi Aramco Mobil Refinery Company Ltd. is seeking an OT Network Engineer to join their team in Yanbu Al Sinaiyah, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical for ensuring the secure, reliable, and continuous operation of the refinery’s Plant Automation Network (PAN) and associated Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity controls. The position requires 2-5 years of experience and plays a vital role in protecting refinery operations from cyber threats, ensuring uninterrupted production, plant safety, and regulatory compliance. Role Purpose and Context The OT Network Engineer is responsible for maintaining the availability, integrity, and security of OT networks that support process control, safety systems, and overall plant operations. This includes adherence to applicable industry standards, corporate cybersecurity requirements, and audit obligations. The role ensures that cybersecurity controls are implemented effectively without compromising plant safety or operational continuity. Key Responsibilities Administer, operate, and maintain the OT Plant Automation Network, including industrial switches, firewalls, and communication infrastructure for DCS, PLCs, SCADA, and SIS. Ensure high availability, performance, and reliability of OT networks supporting 24/7 plant operations. Maintain secure network segmentation and controlled connectivity between OT and external systems. Administer user and service accounts for OT systems, enforcing password control, privilege management, and segregation of duties. Implement and maintain OT cybersecurity controls such as logging, monitoring, antivirus, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, and baseline configuration control. Plan and execute scheduled OT antivirus updates and patching activities, coordinating to minimize production impact. Conduct OT cybersecurity risk assessments for new and existing systems and maintain accurate OT asset inventory and licensing records. Support internal and external OT cybersecurity assessments and audits, developing and tracking corrective action plans. Provide emergency call-out support for OT cybersecurity incidents and participate in investigations, containment, and recovery efforts. Manage and control OT firewalls, network access rules, and secure remote connectivity, monitoring network traffic for anomalies. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in OT network engineering or a related field. Demonstrated understanding of industrial control systems (DCS, PLCs, SCADA, SIS) and their network requirements. Familiarity with industry standards such as ISA/IEC 62443. Experience with network administration, firewall management, and cybersecurity controls implementation. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Yanbu Al Sinaiyah, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia, within a critical refinery operation environment. The role involves supporting 24/7 plant operations and responding to cybersecurity incidents as part of an on-call schedule. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

The company specializes in container storage and handling, empty and laden container operations, reefer services, and related terminal services. This full-time position requires strong technical and operational knowledge of container terminal and depot activities, with the ability to manage and optimize all aspects of terminal operations. Key Responsibilities Managing yard operations Overseeing container handling and storage Optimizing equipment utilization Workforce management Ensuring operational efficiency Maintaining safety standards Enhancing customer service Required Experience and Qualifications 5-10 years of direct experience in container terminals or container depots. Candidates with backgrounds limited to general logistics, freight forwarding, shipping agencies, transportation, or supply chain management will not be considered. Proven ability to manage and optimize all aspects of terminal operations. Location This role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. e26881539de519b5.description: About the Role Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare is seeking a Mortuary Technician to join their team in Al Qatif. This is a full-time technical position responsible for ensuring the dignified, safe, and hygienic operation of the hospital mortuary. The role involves strict adherence to Ministry of Health (MOH) infection control protocols, maintaining the physical chain of custody for deceased patients, and managing environmental safety standards within the cold storage facility. Key Responsibilities Receive bodies from clinical wards, verifying "Dual Identifier" tags and accurately documenting the chain of custody in the Morgue Register. Monitor and record temperature and humidity levels of cold chambers in accordance with established policies and procedures, reporting any deviations immediately. Coordinate terminal cleaning and disinfection of storage units, hydraulic lifts, and all surfaces using hospital-grade agents. Apply specific MOH precautions, such as shrouding or bagging, for bodies identified as High-Risk Infectious (*, COVID-19, MERS). Assist forensic authorities with body identification and sample preservation in cases requiring police involvement. Physically release bodies to authorized family members or municipality services. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 year of relevant experience. A strong understanding of infection control protocols, particularly those mandated by the Ministry of Health, is essential. Ability to maintain accurate records and documentation. Work Environment This role operates within a hospital mortuary setting, requiring adherence to strict safety and hygiene standards. The position is based in Al Ahsaa and is a full-time commitment. Additional Information This job description outlines the primary activities, duties, and responsibilities for the Mortuary Technician role. Please note that duties and responsibilities may be subject to change at any time with or without prior notice.

e27dfa48ece911e9.description: About KBR, Inc. KBR, Inc. is a company driven by innovation and collaboration, dedicated to improving the world responsibly and safely. The organization attracts a diverse workforce and top talent, fostering an environment where expertise thrives on creativity and resourcefulness. Role Overview: Valve Technician II KBR is seeking a Valve Technician II to join its team in Rabigh or Makkah, Makkah region. This full-time role is essential for maintaining rotating equipment in optimal condition. The successful candidate will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of rotating equipment and mechanical systems, ensuring adherence to required standards. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Allocate maintenance activities to various technicians and assemble the necessary team. e2d58d30e14f95a7.description: About the Role: Solution Engineer, Edge Agentic AI Intel is seeking a Solution Engineer, Edge Agentic AI, to serve as the technical representative for Intel's Edge Agentic AI and Physical AI (PhyAI) solutions. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and covers customers across Saudi Arabia and the broader MENA region. The position involves working with city authorities, critical infrastructure operators, and government organizations to design, deploy, and scale next-generation AI solutions for cognitive cities, autonomous operations, and intelligent edge-driven decision making, contributing to Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Strategy for Data and AI (NSDAI). Key Responsibilities Guide customers from initial discovery through the successful deployment of agentic AI and Physical AI solutions powered by Intel technologies. Partner with Saudi and GCC customers to understand their use cases and enable solutions on Intel hardware, accelerating the adoption of Edge Agentic and Phy AI. Conduct technical demonstrations, workshops, and proofs of concept at customer sites. Produce customer-facing technical content in both Arabic and English, including solution briefs, deployment guides, demo scripts, and case studies. Gather field insights and communicate them to the Edge & Phy AI product teams to shape solution roadmaps for the region. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a relevant technical role. Demonstrated experience in advanced engineering and customer engagement, particularly in AI solutions. Proficiency in delivering technical demonstrations, architecting and executing proofs of concept, and validating edge AI and agentic workflows. Ability to work closely with city, government, and AI solutions stakeholders. Strong technical writing skills in both Arabic and English. Work Environment and Team This role is a founding position within Intel's customer success engineering presence in Saudi Arabia. The Solution Engineer will work directly with key AI customers in the Kingdom, contributing to projects that are deployed into production at scale. The role involves close collaboration with Intel's global product and ecosystem organizations. Professional Development The position offers mentorship from senior engineers and customer success leaders, with structured early-career development opportunities. e2e86776be332b47.description: About Mace Group Mace Group integrates construction expertise with consultancy services to enhance potential in projects and redefine ambitious goals. The company's values guide its approach to consulting and define the individuals sought to join its team. Role Overview Mace Group is seeking a Senior Project Manager - Civils & Superstructure to contribute to a significant program in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This part-time position involves supporting the delivery of major civil and superstructure packages for a complex stadium development. The role combines hands-on construction delivery with broader project management and coordination responsibilities, distinct from dedicated night-shift construction roles. Project Context This opportunity is part of one of the largest programs in Saudi Arabia, focusing on a mixed-use development that includes sports facilities, entertainment, arts, and associated infrastructure. The Senior Project Manager will play a key role in the successful execution of this large-scale project. Key Responsibilities Manage civil and superstructure packages throughout the construction and delivery phases. Provide daily project and package management leadership. Monitor construction progress against the established program and agreed deliverables. Ensure the availability of necessary design information to support construction activities. Coordinate interfaces among design, construction, and other project packages. Identify constraints and actively drive the resolution of delivery issues. Collaborate closely with contractors, consultants, and internal project teams. Maintain a consistent site presence while managing broader project requirements. Monitor package risks, interfaces, program adherence, and delivery performance. Provide clear reporting and escalate key project issues as needed. Support the successful completion and handover of assigned works. Candidate Profile Mace Group is looking for an experienced professional to fill this role. e20b0fc863af13ef.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رمز البيئة للمقاولات عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تصميم المباني الجديدة أو الإضافات والتعديلات على المباني القائمة، بالإضافة إلى تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها. يساهم الدور أيضاً في اختيار المواقع والإشراف على أعمال الإنشاءات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع التصاميم لمشاريع الإنشاءات وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات. إعداد نماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات والنماذج الرقمية للمشاريع. المساعدة في عملية اختيار المقاولين والمواد اللازمة للمشاريع. تقديم الدعم لمشروعات الإنشاء ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قبل المقاولين. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل القائمة. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل المهندس المعماري ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تنفيذ مشاريع الشركة المتنوعة. عن رمز البيئة للمقاولات رمز البيئة للمقاولات هي شركة تعمل في مجال المقاولات، وتسعى لتقديم حلول معمارية وهندسية مبتكرة وعملية لمشاريعها في الرياض والمناطق المحيطة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهندسين المعماريين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقدم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين الذين تتوافق مؤهلاتهم مع متطلبات الدور.

e21f790a8ec36549.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المحايد مهندسون استشاريون عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تزيد عن 10 سنوات في المجال الهندسي. سيقوم المهندس المدني بمهام أساسية تتعلق بدراسة المشاريع الإنشائية، إعداد التصاميم، والإشراف على التنفيذ لضمان مطابقة المواصفات والمعايير. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة الجوانب الطبوغرافية والجيولوجية للمواقع الإنشائية، بالإضافة إلى تحليل نتائج اختبارات فحص التربة. تحليل المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية الخاصة بالمشاريع. تحديد أعماق التأسيس المطلوبة للمشاريع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي شامل لعناصرها. إعداد تصاميم المشاريع، ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها، بالإضافة إلى تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة المدنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تزيد عن 10 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية. فهم عميق للمبادئ الهندسية الإنشائية والجيولوجية. القدرة على إعداد وتدقيق المخططات والتصاميم الهندسية. مهارات قوية في الإشراف على المشاريع وضمان الجودة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة المحايد مهندسون استشاريون، ومقر العمل هو مدينة الرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بمهام المشروع والإشراف الميداني عند الحاجة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. نشجع المهندسين المدنيين ذوي الخبرة الواسعة على التقديم.

e2325e3c7e4f2d82.description: About the Role The Saudi National Bank (SNB) is seeking an Assistant Retail Legal Collection Advisor to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is designed for professionals with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on monitoring and managing various written-off and non-performing loan (NPL) portfolios within Retail Banking. The primary objective is to recover the bank's rights from defaulting clients through effective collection strategies and legal actions. Key Responsibilities Engage with defaulting clients to negotiate settlements and initiate lawsuits when necessary, collaborating with and supervising the collection team to secure the bank's rights. Conduct financial analyses for applications related to filing lawsuits. Follow up with clients under the Kafalah program for collection and pursue confiscation of their sponsorship. Monitor and follow up with clients regarding scheduled installment payments, encouraging timely remittance. Implement the legal Retail collection management strategy and monitor its performance to ensure objectives are met. Track the legal positioning of collection clients to stay informed about account developments. Address financial and accounting constraints of defaulting clients within the retail collection portfolio. Review and evaluate client offers, completing necessary steps for presentation to internal authorities. Receive credit approvals and oversee their implementation according to specified conditions. Manage various litigation and dispute settlement activities and negotiations to protect all legal rights. Policy Adherence and Reporting Review departmental policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions to ensure consistent and controlled work execution. Adhere to the Bank’s AML/CTF policy, guidelines, and all SAMA regulations concerning account opening, KYC, and Customer Due Diligence. Comply with the Bank’s Cyber Security policies and all SAMA regulations, supporting SNB in meeting internal, national, and international Cyber Security controls. Prepare periodic quarterly reports on collection management activities. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of relevant professional experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with potential involvement in activities across Jeddah and Dammam. The role operates within the Retail Banking division, collaborating with collection and legal teams to achieve financial recovery objectives. Additional Duties The Assistant Retail Legal Collection Advisor will also perform other related duties or assignments as directed by management.

This full-time role is essential for supporting procurement activities, ensuring effective supplier coordination, and facilitating the timely delivery of necessary materials and services to meet business demands. Monitor supplier performance and ensure adherence to approved procurement policies and procedures. Demonstrated ability to manage purchasing activities and supplier relationships effectively. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a dynamic procurement team to support the operational needs of Albaik Food Systems Co. e2d850c6e1dfa5fd.description: About the Role Sky Systems is seeking an IT Support Engineer for a part-time, on-call independent contractor opportunity in Al Khobar, Eastern Region. This role involves responding to service tickets as they arise, requiring flexibility and availability to address IT infrastructure support needs. Key Responsibilities Provide IT Infrastructure field support, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and operating system issues while adhering to warranty and security compliance. Install, troubleshoot, and repair desktops, printers, laptops, and other computer peripherals, as well as desktop applications. Perform smart hand activities for enterprise LAN and WAN setups under instruction. Offer desk-side support and PC break/fix services, including basic administration of Windows OS, and preferably MAC/Linux OS. Provide smart hand support for peripheral and networking hardware such as monitors, keyboards, mice, printers, routers, switches, and firewalls. Troubleshoot system and network issues using deductive reasoning, including resolving end-user network cabling problems. Analyze repeat calls and develop preventive actions for recurring issues. Manage problem resolution effectively. Technical Requirements Minimum of 2 to 3 years of experience in IT Infrastructure field support. Proficiency in installing and troubleshooting various hardware and software components. Basic understanding of enterprise LAN and WAN concepts. Ability to lift and move computer equipment weighing up to 50 lbs. Expertise in desk-side support and PC break/fix. Knowledge of TCP/IP networking, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and RDP. Experience with ticketing tools such as ServiceNow or Remedy. Preferably an Associate Degree in Electronics and CompTIA A+ Certification. Other vendor certifications from OEMs (Dell, Toshiba, Lenovo, Client) are a plus. General Skills and Attributes Excellent written and oral communication skills for interaction with clients and management. Strong customer management skills and ability to interact with customers at various levels. Driven, result-oriented, and passionate about the work. Ability to work independently or as part of a team with minimal supervision. Proactive ownership and a sense of urgency in completing tasks and meeting deadlines. Work Arrangement This is a part-time, on-call independent contractor position. Candidates must be available to work flexible schedules based on service ticket requirements.

e2f66f3612b486a4.description: About the Role Astek is seeking an experienced Project Manager (HIS) to lead healthcare technology projects for one of its clients. This contract position is based in Makkah, with work locations in Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves overseeing the planning, implementation, integration, and delivery of healthcare technology solutions across the organization. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end HIS implementation projects, including integrations with EMR, EHR, QMS, IVR, ERP, CRM, insurance, laboratory, and radiology systems. Define project scope, deliverables, objectives, and success criteria in collaboration with stakeholders. Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, timelines, milestones, and resource requirements. Ensure adherence to project governance, delivery methodologies, and PMO standards. Act as the primary point of contact between business teams, clinical teams, vendors, technology teams, and TIDES. Manage communication and reporting with senior leadership and executive stakeholders. Ensure alignment with healthcare operations, regulatory requirements, and business objectives. Coordinate with HIS vendors and third-party providers to manage deliverables, contracts, SLAs, and performance. Oversee system integrations and interoperability between HIS and internal or external platforms. Ensure the effective implementation of HL7, FHIR, API, and other interoperability standards. Identify and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans. Drive change management initiatives for clinical and non-clinical users. Oversee SIT, UAT, go-live readiness, data migration, and system performance validation. Prepare regular project status reports covering progress, risks, issues, KPIs, and key decisions. Conduct steering committee meetings and maintain accurate project documentation. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Healthcare Informatics, Computer Science, or a related field; a Master’s degree is preferred. 7+ years of project management experience. 3+ years of experience managing HIS, hospital technology, or healthcare IT projects. PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or equivalent certification is preferred. Strong understanding of at least one HIS platform, such as Cerner, Epic, InterSystems, Oracle Health, or a similar enterprise HIS solution. Experience with HL7, FHIR, API integration, data migration, and system interoperability. Experience managing system integration testing, user acceptance testing, go-live planning, change management, and operational readiness. Experience delivering hospital or multi-facility HIS implementations. Exposure to healthcare digital transformation programs. Experience working in regulated healthcare environments. e23572d1f1d2b008.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة المشورة للمحاماة في الدمام عن حاجتها لضم كاتب محتوى قانوني إبداعي بدوام كامل. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تحويل الموضوعات والنصوص القانونية المعقدة إلى محتوى جذاب وواضح ومفهوم للجمهور، مع الحفاظ على الدقة القانونية وتقديمه بأسلوب شيق. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 5 و10 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات ابتكار أفكار وزوايا طرح للمحتوى القانوني مستمدة من الأنظمة السعودية والمواقف العملية والتساؤلات الشائعة. كتابة محتوى قانوني تسويقي وتوعوي وتثقيفي يعكس هوية الشركة وخبرتها ويناسب الجمهور المستهدف. إعداد سيناريوهات للفيديوهات القصيرة والطويلة، بما يشمل الفكرة، الافتتاحية، تسلسل الطرح، النص، والتصور البصري. تطوير أفكار لبرامج وحلقات البودكاست القانوني، وإعداد محاورها ومقدماتها وأسئلتها والنصوص المصاحبة. تبسيط النصوص والمفاهيم القانونية وتحويلها إلى قصص وأمثلة ورسائل سهلة الفهم دون الإخلال بالمعنى أو الدقة. متابعة المستجدات النظامية والموضوعات ذات الصلة، واقتراح محتوى يواكبها ويلبي اهتمامات الجمهور. التعاون مع الفريق القانوني وفرق التسويق والتصميم والإنتاج لتطوير النصوص حتى تكون جاهزة للنشر أو التسجيل والتصوير. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 و10 سنوات في مجال كتابة المحتوى، ويفضل أن يكون قانونيًا. معرفة جيدة بالأنظمة السعودية والمفاهيم القانونية. موهبة في الكتابة الإبداعية وصناعة الأفكار. شغف بتحويل النصوص القانونية إلى محتوى جذاب ومفهوم. ما نقدمه رواتب تنافسية ومزايا وظيفية تتناسب مع الخبرة والكفاءة وجودة الأعمال. بيئة عمل احترافية ومحفزة تقدر الإبداع وتوفر مساحة لتطوير الأفكار. فرصة للنمو والتطور المهني من خلال العمل المباشر مع فريق من المحامين والمستشارين القانونيين. تجربة في صناعة المحتوى تتضمن المشاركة في تطوير برامج ومحتوى مرئي ومسموع. للتقديم يُرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية مع نماذج من الأعمال السابقة. يُفضل أن تتضمن النماذج محتوى قانونيًا وسيناريو فيديو أو تصورًا لحلقة بودكاست.

e202a46ca5bf3d56.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Manager - Residential Marketing to join their team in Riyadh Province, Riyadh. e28dd7f20802acf1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات عن مدرب رياضي للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الجوف، وتحديداً في قرية العليا والقريات. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال التدريب الرياضي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية اكتشاف ميول اللاعبين ومواهبهم واستعداداتهم، وإعداد خطط لتنميتها وتعزيزها وتنفيذها. إعداد الخطط التدريبية قصيرة وطويلة الأمد، وتطويرها لتحديد عناصر اللياقة البدنية وتنميتها. تطوير المهارات الأساسية للعبة الرياضية التي يتم تدريب اللاعبين عليها، وتقييم أدائهم وتنمية مهاراتهم. إدارة المقابلات الرياضية، وتوجيه اللاعبين وتبديلهم وفقاً لمجريات المقابلة. تطبيق قانون وقواعد اللعبة ومتابعة تطورها بشكل مستمر. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال التدريب الرياضي. القدرة على اكتشاف وتطوير المواهب الرياضية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد الخطط التدريبية وتقييم الأداء. معرفة عميقة بقوانين وقواعد اللعبة الرياضية وتطوراتها. بيئة العمل يعمل المدرب الرياضي ضمن مشروع نظافة وصيانة وتشغيل المدينة السكنية بالحديثة، مما يتطلب الالتزام ببيئة عمل منظمة ومحددة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدن قرية العليا والقريات بمنطقة الجوف. تقديم التقارير يتولى المدرب مسؤولية إعداد وتقديم تقارير عمل دورية توثق تقدم اللاعبين والخطط التدريبية المنفذة، مع ضمان حفظ هذه التقارير بشكل دقيق ومنظم. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

e2518b2823ad72be.description: About the Role SLS The Red Sea is seeking a Credit Manager (Saudi National) to join their team in Umluj, Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is essential for maintaining the hotel's financial health by managing credit operations, overseeing accounts receivable, and ensuring timely collections. The Credit Manager will also be responsible for fostering strong relationships with guests and business partners. The position ensures compliance with hotel policies and financial regulations, contributing to effective financial control and healthy cash flow within the organization. Key Responsibilities Oversee credit operations and accounts receivable to ensure effective financial control and cash flow. Review and approve credit applications for corporate clients, groups, and business partners in line with hotel policies. Establish and monitor credit limits and payment terms in coordination with the Director of Finance. Ensure accurate and timely invoicing, billing, and collection of outstanding payments. Monitor accounts receivable aging reports and follow up on overdue balances to minimize financial risks. Maintain relationships with corporate clients, travel partners, and guests while resolving billing and payment disputes. Collaborate with Sales, Events, and Front Office teams to ensure consistent adherence to credit procedures. Prepare monthly credit reports, aging summaries, reconciliations, and bad debt provisions. Ensure compliance with Saudi regulations, accounting standards, company policies, and internal audit requirements. Maintain accurate credit and billing records using hotel financial systems such as Opera, Sun Systems, and Micros. Identify opportunities to improve credit control procedures, collection efficiency, and financial reporting. Support financial audits by maintaining complete and accurate documentation. Provide guidance and training to relevant departments on credit policies, billing procedures, and financial controls. Report credit performance, outstanding balances, and potential financial risks to the Director of Finance. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. The Saudi Arabia Operations AstraZeneca in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia is undergoing a significant transformation, driven by a commitment to advancing healthcare, innovation, and sustainable growth. The local operations are evolving to better serve patients, collaborate with healthcare stakeholders, and contribute to the Saudi Vision 2030. This involves investment in talent, digital solutions, and new operational methods aimed at enhancing patient outcomes and reinforcing leadership in therapeutic areas. Role Summary: Senior Medical Representative AstraZeneca is seeking a Senior Medical Representative to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves influencing customers' prescribing behavior to achieve sales targets. The successful candidate will develop territory strategies and build strong customer relationships to maximize sales volume and market share for designated products. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Complete all required training, including product examinations. Engage primary care healthcare professionals in discussions regarding approved indications and product efficacy/safety profiles to support on-label prescribing. Collaborate with the Sales Manager to develop a local strategy and business plan to meet or exceed sales and call execution goals within the assigned territory. Drive sales performance and ensure sales forecasts and assigned budgets meet or exceed therapeutic and territory expectations. Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of market, demographic, and managed markets information pertinent to the assigned sales territory. Comply with all regulations concerning interactions with healthcare professionals and the distribution of samples. Ensure excellent medical knowledge and promotional skills related to the assigned disease area and product. Consult with and provide clinical and technical information to healthcare professionals within the assigned territory, in compliance with AstraZeneca policies. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to positively influence customer prescribing behavior. Proven capability to build and maintain strong customer relationships. Understanding of sales targets and market share maximization. Work Environment This role is part of a growing team within AstraZeneca's transforming operations in Saudi Arabia. The environment calls for professionals who can adapt to change and contribute to the future of healthcare in the region.

Our AI agents read, classify, extract, and validate document data, with human review where needed, and connect the results to customers’ existing systems. We help teams across accounting, finance, and other document-heavy operations reduce manual work, while enabling software companies and ERP providers to build with ALQari. As we expand our commercial team, we’re looking for a curious and motivated Sales Development Representative to grow with us. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site role based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, suitable for fresh graduates or candidates with up to one year of relevant experience. You will help potential customers discover ALQari, understand their business needs, and connect them with the team for relevant product demonstrations. Your responsibilities will include: • Researching prospective customers, particularly accounting firms, ERP providers, and software companies. • Starting conversations through LinkedIn, email, and phone. • Qualifying leads and scheduling meetings or product demos. • Following up on inbound inquiries and outbound conversations. • Keeping prospect information and follow-up activities organized in our CRM. • Sharing customer feedback to improve our messaging and outreach. e23664fbe4a05bc0.description: Job description About the role We are looking for an experienced Road Civil 3D Coordinator to join our team on a major infrastructure project in Qiddiya, Saudi Arabia . Working within the project’s design and engineering team, you will be responsible for coordinating Civil 3D road design activities , ensuring consistency and quality across models, drawings and deliverables, and supporting effective collaboration between the different engineering disciplines and project stakeholders. This position is particularly suited to a technically strong Civil 3D professional who combines hands-on modelling expertise with the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary road and infrastructure design activities. Key ResponsibilitiesCivil 3D Coordination Coordinate the production and integration of Civil 3D models for roads and associated infrastructure . Ensure consistency between alignments, profiles, corridors, surfaces, assemblies and related design information. Review Civil 3D models and drawings to identify clashes, inconsistencies and coordination issues. Ensure compliance with project modelling standards, naming conventions and agreed workflows. Support engineers and designers in resolving complex Civil 3D modelling issues. Monitor the quality and consistency of Civil 3D deliverables throughout the design process. Road Design & Multidisciplinary Coordination Coordinate road design interfaces with earthworks, utilities, drainage, structures, landscape and other infrastructure disciplines . Ensure that road geometry and levels are properly coordinated with surrounding infrastructure. Participate in multidisciplinary design reviews and technical coordination meetings. Identify design interfaces and potential conflicts at an early stage and coordinate their resolution with the relevant teams. Support the integration of design changes into the Civil 3D environment. BIM & Digital Delivery Work closely with BIM and design coordination teams to ensure effective integration of Civil 3D models within the wider project digital environment. Contribute to model reviews and coordination processes. Maintain high standards of model quality, accuracy and data consistency. Support the development and implementation of Civil 3D best practices across the project team. Project Delivery Coordinate with designers, engineers, BIM teams, contractors and other project stakeholders. Support the preparation and review of technical deliverables at key project milestones. Track technical issues related to road modelling and coordinate their resolution. Contribute to continuous improvement of design and modelling workflows. Candidate ProfileEducation Degree or technical qualification in Civil Engineering, Roads, Infrastructure Engineering or a related discipline. Experience Significant professional experience in road and infrastructure design . Strong hands-on experience with Autodesk Civil 3D , ideally on large and complex infrastructure projects. Experience coordinating Civil 3D production across multidisciplinary design teams. Previous experience on major international infrastructure, urban development or transport projects would be highly valued. Experience in Saudi Arabia or the Middle East would be an advantage. Technical Skills Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Civil 3D . Strong knowledge of: Road alignments and profiles Corridors and assemblies Digital terrain models and surfaces Grading and earthworks Cross-sections Road interfaces with drainage and utilities Model and drawing production Good understanding of BIM coordination and multidisciplinary modelling workflows . Knowledge of Autodesk Construction Cloud / BIM 360, Navisworks and AutoCAD would be an advantage. Personal Skills Strong technical coordination and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to work effectively within a large multidisciplinary and multicultural project environment. Excellent attention to detail and commitment to design quality. Ability to manage multiple interfaces and priorities. Strong communication and coordination skills. Proactive and collaborative mindset. Professional proficiency in English . Why Join Us? This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a major and technically challenging infrastructure project in Saudi Arabia , working in an international engineering and construction environment. You will play a key role in ensuring the quality and coordination of road design models while collaborating with multidisciplinary teams on a highly visible project. Location: Riyadh / Qiddiya, Saudi Arabia Discipline: Roads & Infrastructure Position: Road Civil 3D Coordinator Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

e2616987fa8af084.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking an experienced Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Expert to establish and lead a robust ERM capability within the organization. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in risk management. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to design, embed, and operationalize a comprehensive ERM framework across all business units. The expert will provide senior leadership and the Board with clear, decision-ready insights into the organization's key risks, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and regulatory standards. Key Responsibilities Design, establish, and operationalize the ERM framework, policy, methodology, and governance structure in line with ISO 31000 and COSO ERM. Develop and maintain the corporate risk register, ensuring risks are clearly defined, owned, assessed, and regularly reviewed. Define the organization's risk appetite and tolerance framework, translating it into practical thresholds for decision-making. Lead enterprise-wide risk assessments, workshops, and prioritization exercises with business and functional leaders. Collaborate with risk owners to develop risk mitigation plans and controls, and track their implementation. Design and monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), including escalation triggers and thresholds. Build risk dashboards and produce clear executive and Board-level risk reporting. Set up and support risk governance forums and committees, including terms of reference, agendas, and follow-up of actions. Embed a risk-aware culture through training, awareness sessions, and guidance for risk owners and champions. Integrate ERM with strategic planning, internal audit, compliance, business continuity, and project governance. Monitor emerging risks and regulatory developments, advising leadership on their potential impact. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in risk management, Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field; Master's or MBA preferred. 10+ years of risk management experience, with significant hands-on experience setting up and running ERM frameworks. Proven track record in building corporate risk registers, risk appetite statements, and KRI frameworks from the ground up. Strong knowledge of ISO 31000, COSO ERM, and related governance and control frameworks. Experience producing executive and Board-level risk reporting and dashboards. Experience in government, semi-government, or regulated sectors in the GCC is highly desirable. Required Skills Excellent facilitation, stakeholder management, and influencing skills at a senior level. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and report-writing skills. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

e2b92145145c92e7.description: About ACWA Power ACWA Power is seeking experienced Maintenance Managers for upcoming full-time opportunities within its power generation and water desalination plants across Saudi Arabia. This role is crucial for ensuring the operational reliability and efficiency of critical plant infrastructure. Role Summary The Maintenance Manager will lead all mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation and control (I&C) maintenance activities. The primary objective is to ensure plant reliability, maximize equipment availability, and manage maintenance operations cost-effectively, adhering to contractual requirements, OEM recommendations, and stringent HSE standards. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement maintenance strategies, long-term maintenance plans, and departmental objectives in alignment with plant requirements and OEM recommendations. Lead preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities across mechanical, electrical, and I&C disciplines to maximize equipment reliability and minimize downtime. Plan and manage major maintenance outages, including scope definition, resource allocation, contractor management, spare parts procurement, budget control, and execution timelines. Monitor maintenance Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) such as equipment availability, Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), preventive maintenance compliance, and maintenance backlog. Drive reliability improvements through systematic root cause analysis. Prepare and manage maintenance operating and capital budgets, ensuring effective cost control and optimal resource utilization. Oversee spare parts inventory, manage OEM service agreements, supervise maintenance contractors, and ensure timely procurement to support continuous operations. Ensure strict compliance with Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) standards, the Integrated Management System (IMS), established maintenance procedures, and all relevant regulatory requirements. Lead, coach, and develop maintenance teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, operational excellence, and effective collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 12 years of experience in maintenance management within power generation or water desalination plants. Demonstrated expertise in leading multi-disciplinary maintenance teams (mechanical, electrical, I&C). Strong understanding of maintenance strategies, planning, and execution. Proficiency in budget management and cost control for maintenance operations. Work Environment This is a plant-based position located in Saudi Arabia. The role requires availability to support critical maintenance activities, planned outages, and emergency situations as needed to ensure operational continuity.

Monitor operational performance, prepare shift updates, and recommend process improvements. Coach and support team members to maintain efficient warehouse operations. e2cde2ce67daf385.description: About the Role J&T Express is seeking an Operations Manager to lead and optimize end-to-end express delivery and hub operations in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves ensuring seamless first-mile, sorting, transportation, and last-mile operations while driving service efficiency, maintaining safety compliance, and meeting operational KPIs. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end logistics operations, including pickup, sorting, transportation, and last-mile parcel delivery. Monitor daily branch/hub activities to ensure operational targets and service level agreements (SLAs) are met consistently. Plan and optimize delivery routes and driver dispatch schedules to reduce transit times and operational costs. Performance and KPI Tracking Track and report on key operational metrics, such as On-Time Delivery (OTD), delivery success rate, and cost-per-parcel. Drive process improvement initiatives to reduce parcel damage, missing rates, and customer complaints. Conduct regular reviews of operational efficiency and present reports to senior management. e2eb3f366382487f.description: About Us Tamara is the leading shopping and payments platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region, with a mission to empower people in their daily lives and revolutionize how they shop, pay, and bank. The company was founded by serial entrepreneur Abdulmajeed Alsukhan along with his partners Turki Bin Zarah and Abdulmohsen Al Babtain. Tamara operates out of its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and has offices in the UAE, Egypt, Germany, and Vietnam. Our large, dedicated team of professionals continues to grow as we expand our reach and impact. Serving millions of users and partnering with thousands of merchants, Tamara collaborates with leading global and regional brands such as SHEIN, Jarir, noon, IKEA, H&M, and Farfetch, as well as local small and medium businesses. The company is backed by SNB Capital and Sanabil Investments, a wholly-owned company by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), Checkout.com, Coatue, Shorooq Partners, and Endeavor Catalyst, among others. Your role We are looking for a Senior Compliance Associate to support the Compliance Department in ensuring full adherence to SAMA regulations applicable to payment services, including activities under the Electronic Money Institution (EMI) license and other Payment Service Provider (PSP) categories. The role involves both advisory and monitoring responsibilities to ensure ongoing regulatory compliance. You are a driven, determined, curious team player, knowing that collective strength means we all win. With a positive outlook, you are solution-oriented–persevering regardless of circumstances, always finding a way through, no matter the challenges. You will effectively find a way to work with everyone through empathy and respect. You will be driven and comfortable with responding quickly with urgency, with the ability to change course without losing momentum and energy, resulting in great success. Your responsibilities Ensure compliance with all applicable SAMA regulations related to payment services (e.g., EMI, PSP, wallet providers). Review and approve new products to ensure alignment with SAMA requirements. Monitor internal processes and product structures for regulatory adherence. Track, interpret, and implement changes from SAMA circulars and regulatory updates. Review and maintain internal policies and procedures to ensure consistency with current SAMA regulations. Ensure receipt and proper dissemination of all circulars and publications issued by SAMA; follow up with relevant departments to ensure timely implementation. Prepare and submit accurate regulatory reports to SAMA within required timelines. Review management reports submitted to SAMA for accuracy and completeness. Coordinate with internal teams to collect and validate data required by SAMA. Support regulatory inspections, audits, and remediation actions as needed. Provide advisory support to internal stakeholders on payment-related compliance matters. Your expertise Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, Finance, or a related field. Minimum 3-5 years of experience in a compliance role at a SAMA-regulated entity operating in the payments sector. Solid understanding of SAMA’s regulatory framework for payment services. Experience in regulatory reporting and policy review. Fluent in English and Arabic (spoken and written). Strong communication, coordination, and analytical skills. Detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.Fluency in English and Arabic.

e2f505681d9aac66.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مدرسة ثنايا المعرفة الأهلية في الطائف، مكة المكرمة، عن معلم لغة عربية للمرحلة المتوسطة للانضمام إلى فريقها. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تدريس طلاب المرحلة المتوسطة في مجال اللغة العربية، مع التركيز على وضع خطط الدروس وتقديم التعليمات الفردية والجماعية لدعم التنمية الأكاديمية للطلاب. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع خطط الدروس بما يتوافق مع المنهج الدراسي والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة، واختيار المصادر التعليمية، وتصميم المواد والدروس وطرق التدريس والمحتوى. تدريس طلاب اللغة العربية، وتقديم الدروس الفردية والجماعية، وتيسير المناقشات، وتكليف الواجبات، وتنظيم الرحلات والأنشطة العملية، وإدارة سلوك الطلاب وتفاعلاتهم. تحديد أهداف تعليمية واضحة، وإعداد الاختبارات والواجبات وإدارتها وتصحيحها لتقييم تقدم الطلاب. تقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم لتحسين الأداء والسلوك، وتحديد الطلاب الذين يحتاجون إلى دعم إضافي وتحديد الطرق المناسبة لتلبية احتياجاتهم. تسجيل الحضور والدرجات وأداء الطلاب بشكل فردي وإعداد التقارير اللازمة، وحضور اجتماعات الموظفين والتنسيق مع الزملاء المدرسين والمسؤولين ومساعدي المدرسين. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال تدريس اللغة العربية. القدرة على وضع خطط الدروس وتصميم المواد التعليمية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل اللفظي والكتابي. القدرة على إدارة سلوك الطلاب وتفاعلاتهم بفعالية. بيئة العمل يعمل المعلم ضمن بيئة تعليمية داعمة في مدرسة ثنايا المعرفة الأهلية، حيث يتعاون مع فريق من المعلمين والإداريين لتقديم أفضل تجربة تعليمية للطلاب. يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الطائف بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتقدم فرصة للمساهمة في تنمية جيل الشباب من خلال تعليم اللغة العربية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

e2b8941495153379.description: Job Description We are seeking a Senior Business Continuity Management (BCM) Specialist to lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the organization’s Business Continuity Management arrangements. Track corrective actions and support business owners in updating BCPs and related documentation. Maintain proper document control, version management, and records of workshops, exercises, validations, and management decisions. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills . Strong report writing and presentation skills. Arabic language capability is an advantage.
